about: Results of the reference cases on the laptop (Intel Core Ultra 7 355, Arch Linux, OpenFOAM v2606 from the AUR), 2026-10-14/15. hpc/setup/compare_reference.py compares the simulation PC's results with them. Tolerances are relative; seconds are for information only (the laptop throttles under load).

checks.note: the laptop used 8 cores here; this result varies by about 1.5 % with small changes
B's own scatter is measured by configs/benchmark/snappy_same_wall_shift_plus1cm.yaml
